positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Backend Software Engineer in the Rider/Pickups squads of the Airports, Events, and Venues team
• Designed and implemented Softmatch at PIN airports, improving the airport pickup experience for riders
• Implemented SMS notifications for Airport Kiosk Experiment
• Facilitated onboarding course promoting best practices for service observability

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Working in the Visual Studio Team Services (VSTS) Package Management team, developing high quality features for VSTS and Team Foundation Server (TFS).
    • Responsible for features such as Release Views, Packaging Build Tasks, and general front-end features.
    • Part of on-call rotation responsible for keeping the SLA of our service.
    • Part of v-team responsible for improving testing practices throughout our Continuous Delivery process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked in the Storage Core test team and helped ship high quality Windows 10 and November Update releases.
    • Implemented Crashdmp telemetry which helped better understand failures when a dump is not created.
    • Helped drive business decisions using information gathered through our telemetry.
    • Implemented telemetry collection and data transformation for Storage Sense on mobile, Copy Offload, Thin Provisioning, Hybrid HDD, Crashdmp, and LiveDump. Also created reporting for the gathered data using a custom XML based language and SQL back end.
    • Automated testing for CPS that allowed quick redeployment of installed builds for our test hardware. This allowed us to quickly test critical hot-fixes for premium CPS customers.
    • Closely monitored customer issues, measured impact through telemetry, and validated hot-fixes.
    • Participated in a virtual team that ensured high quality of Windows 10 Mobile upgrades, making sure our features worked correctly across builds and devices.
    • Owned the HCK certification and feature tests for Copy Offload and Thin Provisioning devices.
    • Responsible for managing the storage hardware lab consisting of SANs from different vendors.

positions.title: SDET Intern
positions.description:
• Worked in the ReFS test team during the Windows 8.1 time frame.
    • Created a virtual disk cache to test file system resiliency during power loss scenarios. The cache captured all I/O sent to disk and stored it for later use, this allowed to increase the number of test cases available. It also reduced the time needed to run the tests while decreasing wear and tear in the hardware.

positions.title: SDET Intern
positions.description:
• Worked in the Storage Core test team during the Windows 8 time frame.
    • Implemented a multi-threaded tool to measure performance of Copy Offload operations. By running the tool with different parameter permutations, copy times were improved by around 25%, from 240 MB/s to 300 MB/s. Results from the tool were stored in a SQL database for easier reporting.
